name: taskshape
description: Cost-aware routing for every sub-agent launch: classifies the task shape and picks the cheapest adequate model. Works with zero configuration (enforce mode rewrites the model, built-in Claude profiles); suggest mode only logs.

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: enforce: rewrite the Agent tool's model to the chosen profile's model; suggest: log the decision and leave the launch unchanged.

command.title: taskshape command
command.description: Optional path to the Python taskshape CLI (for Laya and the lab). Empty: the plugin's built-in rubric routes on its own.

profiles.title: Profiles file
profiles.description: Optional profiles.json (authorized model profiles with capability, cost tier and phases). Empty: built-in Claude profiles (haiku, sonnet, opus).

budget.title: Budget
budget.description: Budget name from profiles.json to route under.

config.title: Config file
config.description: Optional taskshape.json naming an adopted Laya checkpoint; only used with the Python command.

decisions.title: Decisions log
decisions.description: Optional JSONL file for the decision audit trail. Empty: ~/.taskshape/decisions.jsonl (or $CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA).

records.title: Outcome records
records.description: Optional JSONL file for sub-agent outcomes (accepted = the tool call did not error, plus seconds). Empty: ~/.taskshape/outcomes.jsonl.

respectExplicitModel.title: Respect explicit model
respectExplicitModel.description: When the launch already names a model, leave it alone even in enforce mode.
